questions.prompt: What is the capital city of People's Republic of China?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter B and has 7 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the People's Republic of China article.

questions.proof: The capital city is Beijing and Shanghai is the city with the most people living in it.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with People's Republic of China?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter A and has 11 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Geography” part of the People's Republic of China article.

questions.proof: It borders Vietnam, Laos, and Burma in Southeast Asia; India, Bhutan, Nepal and Pakistan in South Asia; Afghanistan, Tajikistan, Kyrgyzstan and Kazakhstan in Central Asia; a small section of Russian Altai and Mongolia in Inner Asia; and the Russian Far East and North Korea in Northeast Asia.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “While China was never actually taken over by Europeans, many European countries, such as Britain and _____ built spheres of influence in China.”

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter F and has 6 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “A new age” part of the People's Republic of China article.

questions.proof: While China was never actually taken over by Europeans, many European countries, such as Britain and France built spheres of influence in China.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Chinese civilization was also one of the few to invent writing, with the others being Mesopotamia, the Indus Valley civilization, the Maya civilization, the Minoan civilization of ancient _____, and Ancient Egypt.”

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter G and has 6 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Ancient (2100 B.C. - 1500 A.D.)” part of the People's Republic of China article.

questions.proof: Chinese civilization was also one of the few to invent writing, with the others being Mesopotamia, the Indus Valley civilization, the Maya civilization, the Minoan civilization of ancient Greece, and Ancient Egypt.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Everest (8848m), is on the border between China and _____.”

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter N and has 5 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Geography” part of the People's Republic of China article.

questions.proof: Everest (8848m), is on the border between China and Nepal.
